purpose: Round-32 F16 captured-source assertions for S049 (网络安全众测平台 helpList, https://zc.cnvd.org.cn/news/helpList) and S050 (360SRC 外部漏洞处理和评分标准 V2.0, https://security.360.cn/Reward/rules), captured in commit 288ea9ac17a78dce644388af35b89aa96b7994da (author time 2026-10-25T23:14:00-03:00) and re-fetched with identical post-conversion text on 2026-10-26 (wave1/ScoutLiveDrift.md). SHA-256 pins bind each committed local capture; each record carries its registry `url` and its `fetched_utc` from the capture commit (C1 rule B/C). Normalization (QUALITY Q8): source-recheck.py normalize() strips capture markup such as <u>...</u> and collapses whitespace to single spaces, and every assertion below was measured exactly-once under that normalization before it was written here, so none carries an anchor. Whitespace collapse inserts a space at a source line wrap, so each assertion is confined to one capture line; the S050 applicability sentence continues on the next line and only its wrap-free clause is asserted. Q6 note: the S049 page carries platform-issued tester VPN account and password acquisition instructions; none of that text is quoted here and no credential, session URL or vault reference is carried.
